segments.text: Here's the most useful money fact nobody wants to hear. Your savings rate matters more than your income, or your investment returns.
You can't control the market. You can't always control your salary. But the gap between what you earn and what you spend? That's yours.
And you don't even need a reason to save. Save for flexibility, for options, for the surprise you can't see coming.
A high savings rate quietly beats a big salary that all gets spent. Boring. Unbeatable.
That's The Psychology of Money. Honest verdict on the channel.
